# Contributing to Lazy Load for Comments

Code contributions, bug reports, and feedback are very welcome. These should be submitted through [the GitHub repository](https://github.com/Joel-James/lazy-load-for-comments).

Development happens in the `dev` branch, and any pull requests should be made against that branch please.

> [!NOTE]  
> GitHub is for bug reports and development-related issues only. For support, please use the [WordPress.org support forums](https://wordpress.org/support/plugin/lazy-load-for-comments/).

## Reviews on WordPress.org

If you enjoy using Lazy Load for Comments I would greatly appreciate it if you left [a positive review on the WordPress.org Plugin Directory](https://wordpress.org/support/plugin/lazy-load-for-comments/reviews/). This is the fastest and easiest way to contribute to Lazy Load for Comments 😄.
